label: Intern
description: Internship or trainee position. Not counted as full-time experience unless explicitly reclassified.

label: Associate
description: Associate-level position such as Associate Product Manager.

label: Mid level
description: Default level for an unqualified professional title such as Product Manager or Business Analyst.

label: Senior
description: Senior individual contributor such as Senior Product Manager.

label: Lead
description: Lead individual contributor or first-line lead such as Lead Product Manager.

label: Group / multi-team lead
description: Leads several product areas or product managers such as Group Product Manager.

label: Head of function
description: Head of a function or product line. Organisation-dependent; often comparable to director.

label: Director
description: Director-level leader such as Director of Product.

label: Executive / C-level
description: Chief officer such as Chief Product Officer.

label: Founder (not ranked)
description: Founder or co-founder. Not comparable on the employee seniority ladder.

label: Unknown
description: Seniority cannot be determined from the available evidence.
